items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah that's when I first met Frankie Lymon.

ctx.x: Yeah that's when I first met Frankie Lymon. We were on the same little TV thing he made -- a little film. And I think we made it in Delaware -- Willmington Delaware. And this little kid was singin' boy -- and I was on the same thing. So in the mean time we were recording for Gotham -- we made a few sides for them. That's where "Frankie and Johnny Boogie" came. #then
Was your music any different then?
